verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an AI agent on its root-cause-analysis docs page that takes a production error and produces a reviewable pull request with a tested fix. The homepage adds that Rollbar connects errors, replays and releases and points to the code behind each error, giving an actionable outcome from AI analysis. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of which signals the AI analyzes (stack trace, breadcrumbs, related commits), a documented human-readable root-cause explanation separate from the PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
